notes.title: Development Deck 5: How To Sail Your Airship
notes.notes: [p]Hey folks,[/p][p]We’ve been working on the airship sailing systems in the game and wanted to share where it’s at and hear what you think.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45650657/670905551111b96ed8f7e069166c31e3db23c370.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Our goal was to make sailing feel like more than just pointing your ship and setting off. In the game, wind direction actually matters. When the wind is at your back or your sides, you generally want to deploy all of your sails if you want to sail at max speeds. Lowering your sails will of course slow you down, but you can manage your speed based on how many sails you deploy. [/p][p][/p][p]You also need to build side sails to maintain lift for your ship, otherwise, you will sink! For times when the wind is not in your favour, you can take all of your sails down (with just a few button presses) and enter what we call 'paddle' mode. This means your ship can continue moving, at a reduced speed, in any direction, regardless of the wind's direction. It adds some real strategy, so you'll want to pay attention to the wind while traveling.[/p][p][/p][p]Later in the game, more advanced ships can be equipped with engines for true freedom of exploration. Engines will need a source of fuel, which luckily, some Guardian types can automatically provide, or you can feed it fuel yourself[/p][p][/p][p][i]Arm your vessel and ready yourself for battle[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45650657/84d7fb298eb4e74d1772590a8cf067cb9eb3d06d.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]A few other key features worth mentioning[/p][list][*][p]Ships are modular, so you can build and customize however you like[/p][/*][*][p]Favorite builds can be saved as blueprints and shared with other players[/p][/*][*][p]Since we’re in the skies, you are free to move in all directions, including up and down. This adds a whole new dimension to exploring [/p][/*][*][p]There are threats up there too like sky pirates, and even a massive cloud-dwelling seasnake. Watch out![/p][/*][*][p]Your Guardians can help crew the ship by manning cannons, repairing, crafting, or farming while you focus on steering[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][i]Tend to chores and upkeep as your airship sails the skies[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45650657/369505b230df43d0abbe9c0d022a3a82a3010b08.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][i]Dangers lurk in the skies...beware[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45650657/e3613999d91dd0da8a65cd495b164be7284829a7.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]What mechanics or little touches would make airship sailing feel great to you? We’re still in active development, so any suggestions could help shape the final system. Please let us know![/p]

notes.title: Development Deck 4: We just hit 100,000 (!!) wishlists on Steam
notes.notes: [p]It’s only been 3 months since we announced Guardians Of The Wild Sky and… we just crossed 100,000 wishlists on Steam![/p][p]From the bottom of our hearts, thank you. Seeing this kind of excitement from all of you is both humbling and incredibly motivating. Every wishlist, every comment, every bit of support fuels us to keep pushing, refining, and giving this project everything we’ve got. To celebrate, we decided to go surfing![/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="CrxthGvpwkc;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]We're a small (but veteran) self-funded studio; we don't have any outside investors, publishers or sources of funding. Everything we are building is being done with our own resources. Your support means the world to us, and we are pouring everything we've got into this project. Hitting this milestone reminds us that we’re on the right track and that we’re building this adventure together with all of you.[/p][p]As many of you know, over the past few weeks we’ve been bringing in small groups of playtesters. Expanding access is our top priority, and the team has been working really hard to make it happen. Right now, our approach has been small and measured. We can only handle so much feedback at a time. We want to make sure we’re listening carefully, learning, and building the best experience possible before opening it up to a larger group. Our ultimate goal is simple: we want everyone to have an amazing time when they step into this world.[/p][p]We’re getting closer to opening the doors to hundreds, and soon after, thousands of players. Thanks for your patience and for bearing with us.[/p][p]Stay up to date with the latest by following us on the platforms below. There’s so much more to come![/p][list][*][p]Discord: [url="https://discord.com/invite/3hww8TwXej"]https://discord.com/invite/3hww8TwXej[/url][/p][/*][*][p]Instagram: [url="https://www.instagram.com/playwildsky"]https://www.instagram.com/playwildsky[/url] [/p][/*][*][p]TikTok: [url="https://www.tiktok.com/@blueislestudios"]https://www.tiktok.com/@blueislestudios[/url] [/p][/*][*][p]Reddit: [url="https://www.reddit.com/r/GuardiansoftheWildSky/"]https://www.reddit.com/r/GuardiansoftheWildSky/[/url][/p][/*][*][p]YouTube: [dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/@playwildsky"][/dynamiclink][/p][/*][*][p]Facebook: [url="https://www.facebook.com/playwildsky/"]https://www.facebook.com/playwildsky/[/url][/p][/*][/list][p][/p]

notes.title: Development Deck 3: Our soundtrack is being composed by Andreas Waldetoft
notes.notes: [p]Hey everyone,[/p][p]We’re excited to share some big news about the game: our soundtrack is being composed by [b]Andreas Waldetoft[/b]![/p][p]If you’ve played titles like [i]Crusader Kings II & III, Stellaris, Hearts of Iron IV, Europa Universalis IV[/i] and more, you’ve already heard his incredible work. All of us at the studio have been fans of Andreas' work for a long time so it's been pretty awesome getting to collaborate with him. [/p][p]From the very first sketches, Andreas really captured the tone and atmosphere of our world. The soudtrack isn't final yet, there is still a lot to do but we just wanted to share an early WIP of one of our favorite tracks, meant to be used in our tropical environments. Check it out: [/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="8NcodNrMSvU;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h3][b]Behind The Scenes[/b][/h3][p align="start"]We approached the soundtrack process with a thoughtful and layered mindset by:[/p][olist][*][p]Starting with MIDI mockups with virtual instruments and getting the foundational arrangement right.[/p][/*][*][p]Adding live players selectively and focusing on where acoustic nuance truly elevates the track.[/p][/*][/olist][p]Our first live-instrument test featured flutes performed by the very talented [u][url="https://www.powerflute.ch/"]Sandro Friedrich[/url][/u], who we previously worked with on our game [i]Valley[/i]. Everything you’ll hear is still fairly rough and unfinished. Some of the music will go through proper mixing and polish before launch. But even in this early state, the addition of live flutes completely changed the track’s energy compared to the mockup. [/p][p]Here it is with the live flute: [url="https://youtu.be/z5kozEWs3fw"]https://youtu.be/z5kozEWs3fw[/url][/p][p][/p][p align="start"]We've also been tapping into our own team’s talents. Our Technical Director and co-founder, Brenden Frank, happens to have a real knack for music, so he recorded piano renditions to bring our quieter nighttime sequences to life. The idea was to take Andreas’ tracks and have Brenden play them live on piano for a slower, nighttime version which would expand the soundtrack and reinforce the theme.[/p][p align="start"]You can listen here if you're interested in hearing the differences:[/p][list][*][p]Andreas’ WIP Version (No Piano): [url="https://youtu.be/U0tKBOVDfzc"]https://youtu.be/U0tKBOVDfzc[/url][/p][/*][*][p]Brenden’s Version (Live Piano): [url="https://youtu.be/O6n6DhVo4f8"]https://youtu.be/O6n6DhVo4f8[/url][/p][/*][/list][p]Let us know what you think so far! We have so much more to share in terms of development with everyone. Thanks for your patience with us, please stay tuned for more! We have so much to share soon.[/p]

notes.title: Development Deck 2: First Gameplay Demo & Playtest Key Giveaway
notes.notes:
[p]Hi everyone,[/p][p][/p][p]We’ve just reached another exciting milestone following our closed playtests and we’re thrilled to share what we’ve learned and what’s coming next. [/p][p]Over the past few weeks, it’s been incredible watching how players engage with the world and interact with the game’s core systems. We are still learning something new from each playtest, and as we continue development we will gradually open this up to a wider group of players.[/p][p][/p][p]Before we get into more details, we’re excited to share our very first gameplay demo:[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="8D-DoXOE9Tc;full"][/previewyoutube][p]This video offers a first look at the current state of the game and highlights some major updates we’ve been working on:
 [/p][h3]
[b]Gameplay & Lore[/b][/h3][p]One of the most requested features has been a deeper quest system. Alongside the main questline with your big overarching objective, you’ll discover islands scattered across the world, each with towns or points of interest. Here, you’ll meet quest-givers offering side quests; some simple, others evolving into larger quest chains that expand the lore and deepen your journey.
 [/p][h3][b]Guardian Catching Mechanics[/b][/h3][p]We’ve reworked the Guardian catching mechanic based on early feedback. The new design is far more interactive acting like a catching trap, integrating a magic force for a more immersive and dynamic capturing experience. It’s no longer just about throwing and hoping, you now have more control when planning and placing your trap to successfully capture a Guardian. Originally with our throw and capture mechanic you could waste Capture Crystals by missing your target. Now if your trap misses or you want to reposition it, no problem! Simply pick it back up and deploy it again.
 [/p][h3][b]Building & Survival[/b][/h3][p]Many of our playtesters have come from survival game backgrounds, so we’ve leaned into that, adding more traditional survival elements to increase challenge and replayability. Nightfall has become a lot more dangerous: hostile Guardian spawn rates have ramped up, some types of food spoil, whether the player is wet or in cold or hot temperature has to be taken into account, and that’s just the beginning! We of course recognize not all these features are for everyone so many of them can be turned off, giving the player a cozier experience overall.[/p][p]
[/p][p]Building continues to be one of the most loved systems in the game. Thanks to your feedback, we've expanded the building system with new structure types and decorative elements. You can now discover building recipes from merchants, including nature-themed decor, perfect for crafting your own secluded hideaway deep in the wilderness. Building in Wild Sky represents a significant improvement over previous titles. Pieces can be rotated in all directions, copied, and replaced with higher tier structure pieces. We’ve added loads of QOL features such as multiple snap modes, magnetized attachment points and having ctrl-z undo build actions. You can also build on your ship or even build entirely new ships of your own.
 [/p][h3][b]World Design[/b][/h3][p]Each biome in the game is home to a unique town or settlement, offering valuable items, crafting materials, and recipes. Hoist your sails and rally your crew for a journey through the clouds. While sailing between biomes, you can stay productive by crafting items at your ship’s workbench, you can even deploy your Guardians (or should we say “crew”) to assist with crafting along the way.[/p][p]
[/p][p]Once you have reached your destination, be on the look out, each biome has their own distinct weather patterns, some are rainy while others are cloaked in fog. Additionally, certain Guardians only appear in specific regions, adding depth to exploration and collection.[/p][p]
[/p][h2]What’s Next: Open Playtests[/h2][p]Since our closed playtests, one of the most common questions has been: [i]“When will we gain access to the game?”[/i] To that we say: [b]soon™!
[/b][/p][p]So far, all testing has been under NDA, but over the next few weeks we’ll be gradually adding more players as we implement key changes and squash bugs. Once the game is ready for larger groups, we’ll scale up further. The good news? Initial responses and playtest observations have been really encouraging, we’re eager to get the game into more of your hands as quickly as we can.
[/p][p]When we first opened sign-ups, we never expected over [b]40,000 of you[/b] to join. That support has been incredible, and we’re so grateful. Our goal is to get as many of you into the game as possible, but we ask for your patience as invites roll out.
[/p][p]In the meantime, we’re carefully working through all the feedback we’ve received and steadily iterating on your suggestions. A detailed update highlighting the improvements based on playtester input is on the way, so stay tuned!
[/p][p]And finally, to show our appreciation, we’re giving away [b]100 guaranteed playtest keys.[/b][/p][p] [/p][p][b]Here’s how to enter:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Click on our [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1579420/Guardians_of_the_Wild_Sky/"][u]Steam [/u][/url]page and under the game’s description you will see tags [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Press the \[ + ] icon and suggest some tags you feel that represent the game (e.g. Survival, Open World, Magic, Crafting - whatever fits!)[/p][/*][*][p]Leave a comment on this post telling us: Are you the Builder or a Fighter in survival games?[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][p]That’s it! We’ll randomly select 100 participants to receive guaranteed access to the next round of playtesting.[/p][p]
 [/p]

notes.title: The Gates Have Opened…
notes.notes:
[p]A small wave of players has already taken to the skies. They’ve been testing airships, meeting Guardians, and braving the unknown.[/p][h3] [/h3][p]From our side of the clouds, it’s been incredible to watch. We’ve learned so much from seeing how players interact with the world, and we’ve been making tweaks and improvements along the way.
[/p][p]With over 40,000 playtests signups, the interest and feedback have been overwhelming… but in the best way. Many of you may not know, but we’re a small team of just 12 people. We’d love to let everyone in right now, but we’re taking a careful, measured approach to make sure we get this right.
[/p][p]We want to deliver the best possible experience, and every bit of feedback helps us get closer to that goal. Thank you all for your patience and support, it means the world to us.
[/p][p]While the next invitations are prepared, we want to hear from you:
If you were among the first to set sail, what’s the very first thing you’d do?[/p][list][*][p]Sail the skies for danger?[/p][/*][*][p]Befriend local Guardians?[/p][/*][*][p]Go straight for treasure and dungeons?[/p][/*][*][p]Build an epic base?[/p][/*][/list][p]
If you haven’t already, you can follow our socials linked below to stay up to date on the latest news from our team or join our Discord! [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45650657/7d981add4f9a9c890ad7229bdea5a3678c4c545b.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Playtest sign ups - Request Access now!
notes.notes:
[h3]Ahoy! We are excited to announce that playtest signups are now live. [/h3][p][/p][previewyoutube="MQHbCpFBFIs;full"][/previewyoutube][p]
If you’re a fan of survival crafting games, we’d love your feedback. If you also enjoy cozy games or creature collections games, we encourage you to sign up as well! While the early stages are especially focused on refining the survival crafting experience, we’re working to make Guardians of the Wild Sky accessible to a wide range of players. Please note that this is a PC playtest only at this time.
[/p][h3]How to Sign up:[/h3][olist][*][p]Click on our [url="https://playwildsky.com/signups"]website[/url][/p][/*][*][p]Fill out the form & click submit[/p][/*][*][p]And you're done. It's that easy![/p][/*][/olist][p]We will be rolling out invites over the course of a few weeks, so keep your eyes on your inbox for an invitation. We will be starting smaller and gradually expanding the size of the playtest as we go, so don’t worry if you don’t see an invitation to join right away.
[/p][p]We encourage you to join our Discord so you do not miss out on any news.
[/p][p][/p][h3]And that’s not all… we wanted to share a new feature we’ve been working on for the game: Surfing![/h3][p]
We wanted this to feel seamless and intuitive for players of all levels. It was important for us to have an easy transition from land to sea, making water exploration a brand new and exciting way to explore the world. Plus, you can do jumps and other things, just for the fun of it. We would love to hear your thoughts![/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="INpCaeIrc5M;full"][/previewyoutube][p]
[/p][p]There is much more to come, stay tuned![/p]

notes.title: Development Deck 1: Set sail into the Wild Sky
notes.notes:
[h3]Hey everyone!
[/h3][p][/p][p]We just wanted to take a moment to say thank you for the overwhelming positive response we've received so far. All of the feedback from the community is being reviewed carefully; with your voice we are changing the game in real time. From everyone at the studio, we thank you for the support and we hope you look forward to what is yet to come! 
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45650657/dc5fa21bb79149dddeef1d281aa900d9947ace1a.gif"][/img][/p][p]
[/p][h3][b]Upcoming Gameplay Demo & Multiplayer Details[/b][/h3][p]We know you’re eager to see more, and we’re excited to announce that we have a gameplay demo in the works, please keep your eyes on the sky (actually your computers) for that to appear in the next few weeks. [/p][p]We’re also working hard behind the scenes to bring you more information about multiplayer co-op, including how it will function and what you can expect at launch. Stay tuned — there’s a lot of good stuff coming.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Closed Community Playtest Coming Soon[/b][/h3][p]We’re getting ready to open the doors to a closed playtest, and we want our community to be a part of it. If you’re interested in helping us test the game early and provide feedback, make sure to wishlist the game and keep your eyes on our Discord — that’s where all the playtest announcements and sign-up info will be posted first.[/p][p] [/p][h3][b]Meet the Guardian – The Rat King[/b][/h3][p]We are working on an introduction video to our Guardians, and without sharing that yet we have a small teaser of one of the kings of the skies, introducing the Rat King Guardian. To give you a taste, we’ve created a short combat video featuring the Rat King. He’s quad-dual wielding, sword swinging, relentless, rat and is ready to test your skills. [/p][previewyoutube="B4kMTcN0hZI;full"][/previewyoutube][p]We’re thrilled to announce our partnership with the talented folks at Studio Neon Goose, who are helping bring some of our most iconic enemies — the Guardians — to life. Their work on the characters is absolutely next-level.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45650657/22f9469e651a321d996d0108562883e57e37ac7e.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45650657/5a777f90487c8c013824f484a7c42649831fb455.png"][/img][/p][p]  [/p][h3][b]Critters of the Wild[/b][/h3][p]We’ve just released a short video showcasing some of the critters that roam the world. These creatures are vital resources for your survival, you better keep an eye out… the ecosystem is constantly evolving. Deep into the cloud sea you may find creatures looking to find their way back home… [/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="xyqHKp6YbBA;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h3][b]Playing With Light[/b][/h3][p]We've been working on cave ambiance and nighttime lighting and thought this was a cool shot! A lot of the caves sprinkled throughout the world are dark, almost pitch black and when the light hits it right, it offers a beautiful ray of hope to escape the darkness. [/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="k1hwKkI33OQ;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]That’s all for our beta dev blog, please look forward to our next installment where we dive a lot deeper into the world and the mechanics and possibly more info on our next playtest.[/p][p]



[/p]

notes.title: Welcome to Guardians of the Wild Sky
notes.notes:
[h3]We are thrilled to have you join our journey through the clouds; we have a lot in store for you and we can’t wait to shape the skies with all of you.  [/h3][h3][/h3][h3]Let’s dive into some of the juicy content coming your way![/h3][p][/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45650657/e7b1de567616dcd5fdff1714503f6dab8b802c03.gif"][/img][/h3][h3]Capturing Guardians[/h3][p]At the heart of your journey are the Guardians; extraordinary creatures brimming with elemental magic and unique personalities. They are more than companions; they’re your partners in shaping the skies. Capture Guardians and they can help you build your base, be put to work on your airships, or take on deadly foes in combat. You need to do your part, too. Keep your guardians happy, well rested and well fed![/p][p][/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45650657/fc122736809cbce66bba08f33b7979b88241e2f6.gif"][/img][/h3][h3]Survive, Build & Sail[/h3][p]Whether you're building for survival or style, the construction possibilities are nearly endless. Wild Sky offers an extensive library of decorations, building materials and shapes to build on land, but that’s not all…[/p][p]Take your base with you on the go! There are many ways to explore the world; you can construct an airship for faster sailing, or, you can build an entire flying base and lift off. You and your Guardians can continue crafting, farming, cooking, and more, all while sailing from island to island. Never miss the comforts of home again.[/p][p][/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45650657/a63d6b6de79c26f5d56c49db608c397f73fb84da.gif"][/img][/h3][h3]Explore Unique Biomes[/h3][p]Explore a vast cloud sea spanning hundreds of kilometers as you uncover hidden lands made up of thousands of floating islands. Each archipelago has its own dynamic environment that hosts a plethora of flora and fauna, to either aid or hinder your survival. Be warned, as you venture deeper into the heart of each island… you may come face to face with deadly enemies ready to protect their sacred lands.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45650657/4a06c3086a5ab612b34e76e5e23728fdfd3818bc.gif"][/img][/p][h3]Challenge the Titans[/h3][p]Danger is lurking everywhere, if you seek it. Team up with your friends or brave the wilds alone as you embark on an epic adventure to uncover shadowy caves, ancient dungeons and treacherous foes. Challenge the Titan’s in pursuit of valuable loot and gear. Or, build trophies to showcase your mastery of the great beasts.[/p][p][/p][h2]What’s Next and How to Get Involved[/h2][p]
This is just a snippet of what the game is - we have so much more to share with you, and we’re thrilled to have you join this journey with us. We encourage you to become a member of our Discord as we are quickly gearing up for closed playtesting. [/p][p]Developing this game has been a true labor of love for our small team. We have been working at this for a long time and we intend to continue development for years to come. We are pouring all of our passion and excitement into the project, and we hope it shows. We have a [b]lot[/b] more to share with you, so please stay tuned for more game updates. [/p][p]If you haven’t done so yet we would appreciate your wishlist, and feel free to suggest some tags you believe fit the game![/p][list][*][p]Click on our [u][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1579420/Guardians_of_the_Wild_Sky"]Steam page[/url][/u] and under the game’s description you will see tags [/p][/*][*][p]Press the \[ + ] icon and suggest some tags you feel that represent the game[/p][/*][*][p]Bonus would be to tag a friend in the comments that you would like to play alongside with in the clouds[/p][/*][/list][p]This will help us greatly with the algorithm on Steam and will help suggest the Wild Sky to people who have played similar games, hopefully strengthening and building our community. [/p][p]We have a lot more in store for you all, and we hope you stick around and see where the skies will take you.  [/p]
